projects.name: ImmuStore DB
projects.summary: A distributed database engine written from scratch in pure Python.
bullets: Copy on write B+ tree with crash safe commits, MVCC snapshots, and optimistic transactions.
Raft replication with automatic failover, a Redis protocol server, and deterministic simulation testing.
projects.resumeLine: Pure Python database engine with a copy on write B+ tree, MVCC, and Raft replication.

projects.name: Nodechain Lab
projects.summary: A real time blockchain network built from scratch in Node.js.
bullets: Proof of work mining with retargeting difficulty and secp256k1 signed transactions.
WebSocket gossip with heaviest chain consensus that resyncs forks, shown on a live dashboard.
projects.resumeLine: Real time Node.js blockchain with proof of work, signed transactions, and WebSocket gossip.

projects.name: RustV OS Lab
projects.summary: A bare metal RISC V kernel written in Rust that boots QEMU without firmware.
bullets: Preemptive round robin scheduler, Sv39 paging, and user mode syscalls through ecall.
Hand built virtio block driver, with CI that boots the kernel headless in QEMU.
projects.resumeLine: Bare metal RISC V kernel in Rust with preemptive scheduling, Sv39 paging, and a virtio block driver.

projects.name: Litestar
projects.summary: Co authored a merged fix to the Litestar Python ASGI framework, Aug, 2024.
bullets: Wrapped all middleware in OpenTelemetry tracing so exceptions in the outermost layer are captured.
Spans are now created for every request, and errors are logged under the correct span.
projects.resumeLine: Co authored a merged OpenTelemetry tracing fix covering all middleware.

I learn systems from **first principles**, which is why I have written a database engine with Raft and MVCC, a RISC V kernel in Rust, and a peer to peer blockchain.
I am looking for **backend and full stack roles** on technically challenging products.
